question: 'Vidyalaya' shabd me kaun si sandhi hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Vidya + Aalaya = Vidyalaya; do swar (a + aa = aa, dirgha) milne se Swar Sandhi hoti hai. | Galat kyun: Vyanjan sandhi me vyanjan milte hain (jaise Sat+Jan = Sajjan); Visarg sandhi me visarg (:) milta hai (jaise Ni:+Rog = Nirog); 'koi nahi' galat hai kyunki sandhi spasht hai. | Concept: Sandhi ke 3 prakar — swar, vyanjan, visarg. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Vidya + Aalaya — do swar mile, isliye Swar Sandhi. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.1.

question: 'Mahatma' shabd ka sandhi-vichhed kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Maha + Atma = Mahatma (a + aa = aa, swar sandhi). | Galat kyun: 'Mahat + Ma', 'Maha + Tma' aur 'Mah + Atma' galat vichhed hain — 'Maha' aur 'Atma' hi sahi do shabd hain. | Concept: Sandhi-vichhed — jode hue shabd ko uske mool shabdon me todna. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Mahatma = Maha (bada) + Atma. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.1.

question: 'Rajkumar' me kaun sa samas hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Rajkumar = Raja ka Kumar; dusra pad (Kumar) pradhana hai aur 'ka' vibhakti lupt hai — Tatpurush samas. | Galat kyun: Dvandva me dono pad pradhana hote hain (Mata-Pita); Dvigu me pehla pad sankhya hota hai (Tribhuvan); Bahuvrihi me teesra arth pradhana hota hai (Dashanan). | Concept: Tatpurush — dusra pad pradhana, vibhakti lupt. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 'Raja ka Kumar' — 'ka' chhupa hai, isliye Tatpurush. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.2.

question: 'Mata-Pita' me kaun sa samas hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Mata-Pita me dono pad pradhana hain ('Mata aur Pita' ka bhav) — Dvandva samas. | Galat kyun: Bahuvrihi me teesra arth pradhana hota hai; Karmadharaya me visheshan+visheshya hota hai; Tatpurush me dusra pad pradhana hota hai. | Concept: Dvandva — dono pad barabar, 'aur' ka bhav. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Mata-Pita, Raat-Din — dono barabar, Dvandva. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.2.

question: 'Dashanan' me kaun sa samas hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Dashanan (Ravan) — 'dash' (das) + 'anan' (mukh) se bana shabd kisi teesre (Ravan) ko darshata hai, isliye Bahuvrihi samas. | Galat kyun: Dvigu me pehla pad sankhya hota hai par arth samuh ka hota hai (Tribhuvan); Tatpurush me dusra pad pradhana hota hai; Dvandva me dono pad pradhana hote hain. | Concept: Bahuvrihi — shabd ka arth uske dono padon se alag, teesre ko darshata hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Dashanan = das mukh wala (Ravan) — teesra arth, Bahuvrihi. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.2.

question: 'त्रिभुवन' me kaun sa samas hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Tribhuvan me pehla pad sankhya hai (Tri = 3), isliye Dvigu samas. | Galat kyun: Dvandva me dono pad pradhana hote hain; Tatpurush me dusra pad pradhana hota hai; Bahuvrihi me teesra arth pradhana hota hai. | Concept: Dvigu — pehla pad sankhyavachak. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Tri (3) + Bhuvan — sankhya dikhe to Dvigu; jaise Panchvati (5). | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.2.

question: 'Kaurav' shabd me kaun sa pratyay hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Kaurav = Kuru + A; 'A' (अण्) pratyay lagne se 'Kuru ke vanshaj' ka arth banta hai — Kaurav. | Galat kyun: 'Kaur + Av' aur 'Ku + Rav' galat vichhed hain; 'Kaurav me koi pratyay nahi' galat hai kyunki 'A' pratyay spasht hai. | Concept: Pratyay — shabd ke ant me judkar naya arth banata hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kuru + A = Kaurav (u → au, vriddhi). | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.3; PYQ 2024-P2 Q23 (Pratyay – Kaurav, dataset subtopic, ShikshaNagari official-key solved).

question: 'Jal' ka paryayvachi kaun sa nahi hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Jal ke paryayvachi Pani, Neer, Vari hain; Agni (aag) Jal ka paryayvachi nahi hai. | Galat kyun: Neer, Vari aur Pani teeno Jal ke sahi paryayvachi hain. | Concept: Paryayvachi — ek arth, alag shabd; 'kaun sa nahi hai' wale prashn me galat option dhoondho. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jal = Pani, Neer, Vari — Agni to aag hai, pani ki vipreet. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.4.

question: 'Sukh' ka vilom kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Sukh ka vilom Dukh hai. | Galat kyun: Anand aur Khushi Sukh ke paryayvachi hain (ulta nahi); Shanti ka vilom Ashanti hai. | Concept: Vilom — vipreet arth wala shabd. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Sukh–Dukh, Jay–Parajay — jode me yaad rakho. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.4.

question: 'Jo kabhi na mare' — ek shabd kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 'Jo kabhi na mare' — Amar (a + mar = na marne wala). | Galat kyun: Ajay = jo jeeta na ja sake; Anant = jiska ant na ho; Akash = aakash (ek sthan/vastu). | Concept: Anek shabdon ke liye ek shabd. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Amar = kabhi na marne wala; Adrishya = jo dikhai na de. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.4.

question: 'Aankhon ka tara hona' muhavare ka arth kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — 'Aankhon ka tara hona' ka arth hai bahut priya hona. | Galat kyun: Ghabra jana (haath-paanv phoolna), hairan hona (daanton tale ungli dabana) aur gussa hona alag muhavaron ke arth hain. | Concept: Muhavara — shabdik arth se alag, ruddha arth. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Aankhon ka tara = sabse pyara (jaise aankh ki putli). | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.5.

question: 'Naak me dam karna' ka arth kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 'Naak me dam karna' ka arth hai bahut pareshan karna. | Galat kyun: Chup rehna, khush hona aur madad karna is muhavare ke arth nahi hain. | Concept: Muhavara — shabdik arth se alag, ruddha arth. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Naak me dam = saans lena mushkil kar dena, pareshan karna. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.5.

question: 'Pustak' ka ling kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — 'Pustak' stree-ling hai ('pustak padhi jati hai' — kriya stree-ling me). | Galat kyun: Pulling nahi ('Granth' pulling hai); Napunsak Hindi me nahi hota; 'dono' galat hai. | Concept: Ling — shabd ke saath kriya/visheshan ka roop badalta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pustak (stree) vs Granth (pulling) — jode me yaad rakho. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.3.

question: 'Main jata hoon' — kaun sa kaal hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — 'Main jata hoon' me kriya vartaman me chal rahi hai — Vartaman kaal. | Galat kyun: Bhoot kaal hota to 'main gaya' hota; Bhavishya hota to 'main jaunga' hota. | Concept: Kaal — kriya ke samay se pehchan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 'hoon' dikhe to vartaman; 'gaya' bhoot; 'jaunga' bhavishya. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.3.

question: 'Neelkanth' me kaun sa samas hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Neelkanth (neela kanth wala — Shiv): dono shabdon se alag teesra arth (Shiv) pradhana hai, isliye Bahuvrihi samas hai. | Galat kyun: Tatpurush me dusra pad pradhana hota hai ('Raja ka Kumar'); Dvandva me dono pad pradhana hote hain; Dvigu me pehla pad sankhya hota hai. Karmadharaya bhi nahi — Karmadharaya me visheshan+visheshya ka arth wahi rehta hai (jaise Mahatma = mahan atma), jabki yahan arth teesre (Shiv) ki or jata hai. | Concept: Bahuvrihi — teesra arth pradhana. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Neelkanth, Dashanan, Lambodar — teeno Bahuvrihi (teesra arth). | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.2; AUDIT_CORRECTION_REGISTER.md §C (key sudhara gaya: Karmadharaya → Bahuvrihi).

question: 'Surya' ka paryayvachi kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Surya ke paryayvachi Ravi, Bhanu, Dinakar hain. | Galat kyun: Tara (star), Badal (cloud) aur Chandra (moon) Surya ke paryayvachi nahi hain. | Concept: Paryayvachi — ek arth, alag shabd. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Surya = Ravi, Bhanu, Dinakar. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.4.

question: 'Yathashakti' me kaun sa samas hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Yathashakti me pehla pad avyaya (Yatha) hai — Avyayibhav samas. | Galat kyun: Dvandva me dono pad pradhana hote hain; Bahuvrihi me teesra arth pradhana hota hai; Tatpurush me dusra pad pradhana hota hai. | Concept: Avyayibhav — pehla pad avyaya (yatha, prati, anu). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Yathashakti, Pratidin — pehla shabd avyaya dikhe to Avyayibhav. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.2.

question: 'Pr' + 'Har' = ?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Pr + Har = Prahar; 'Pr' shabd ke pehle judne wala upsarg hai. | Galat kyun: Anhar, Sanhar aur Vihar alag upsarg (An, Sam, Vi) se bante hain — Pr se nahi. | Concept: Upsarg — shabd ke pehle judkar arth badalta hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Pr + Har = Prahar (jaise Pr + Bhav = Prabhav). | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.3.

question: Veer Ras kis bhav se sambandhit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Veer Ras sahas aur yuddh se sambandhit hai. ⚠️ EXTRA — Ras 2026 12th-level syllabus me NAHI hai (Graduation-level / general awareness only); low priority. | Galat kyun: Hasya (hasya bhav), Prem (shringaar ras) aur Karuna (karun ras) alag ras hain. | Concept: Ras — kavya ka bhav; Veer Ras = sahas/yuddh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Veer = yoddha ka sahas. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.6 (EXTRA).

question: 'Din' aur 'Deen' kya hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Din (day) aur Deen (gareeb) — uchcharan samaan, arth alag — Samshruti (homophone) shabd hain. | Galat kyun: Samas shabd-jod hai; Vilom vipreet arth hai; Paryayvachi ek arth wale alag shabd hain — yahan arth alag hai, isliye koi nahi. | Concept: Samshruti — sunne me ek jaise, arth me alag. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Din–Deen, Ann–Anya — sunne me ek, arth alag. | Source: notes/12_general_hindi.md §12.4.
